name: Ricardo Mendoza
bio:
Ricardo Mendoza's career began in law enforcement in Mexico City, where he spent over a decade honing his skills in risk assessment and security protocols. A lifelong motorsports enthusiast, Ricardo transitioned his expertise to the racing world after a chance encounter with a team owner who recognized his potential. He quickly established himself as a meticulous and dependable security chief.

At Rexal FMI Racing, Ricardo is known for his calm and methodical approach. He's obsessed with details, reviewing every aspect of security from paddock access to transport logistics. He believes that a robust security framework is not just about preventing threats but creating a safe and focused environment for the team to perform at their best. Ricardo's unflappable demeanor and his ability to anticipate potential problems have made him an invaluable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: A powerfully built man, Ricardo has a serious demeanor with a kind glint in his eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously documenting everything.
Has a habit of adjusting his tie, even when he isn't wearing one.
Insists on personally inspecting every vehicle before it leaves the garage.
